comment:
* This class is a Selector implementation for X.509 certificate revocation
 * lists.
 * 
 * @see com.android.org.bouncycastle.util.Selector
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public boolean isIssuingDistributionPointEnabled()
methods.comment:
* Returns if the issuing distribution point criteria should be applied. * Defaults to false. *

* You may also set the issuing distribution point criteria if not a missing * issuing distribution point should be assumed. * * @return Returns if the issuing distribution point check is enabled.

methods.name: public boolean isDeltaCRLIndicatorEnabled()
methods.comment: * Returns if this selector must match CRLs with the delta CRL indicator * extension set. Defaults to false. * * @return Returns true if only CRLs with the delta CRL * indicator extension are selected.

methods.name: public boolean isCompleteCRLEnabled()
methods.comment: * If true only complete CRLs are returned. Defaults to * false. * * @return true if only complete CRLs are returned.

methods.name: public BigInteger getMaxBaseCRLNumber()
methods.comment: * Get the maximum base CRL number. Defaults to null. * * @return Returns the maximum base CRL number.

methods.name: public byte[] getIssuingDistributionPoint()
methods.comment:
* Returns the issuing distribution point. Defaults to null, * which is a missing issuing distribution point extension. *

* The internal byte array is cloned before it is returned. *

* The criteria must be enable with Builder.setIssuingDistributionPointEnabled(boolean)}. * * @return Returns the issuing distribution point.

methods.name: public static Collection<? extends CRL> getCRLs(final PKIXCRLStoreSelector selector, CertStore certStore) throws CertStoreException

methodNames: public static Collection<? extends CRL> getCRLs(final PKIXCRLStoreSelector selector, CertStore certStore) throws CertStoreException
